method: Static line-by-line read of all source/config files plus a successful dotnet build (0 errors, 35 nullable warnings). App was not run (needs RabbitMQ, Selenium Grid, ICEGATE credentials, mailbox service).
summary: Fire-and-forget IRN generation: an ASP.NET Core API accepts jobs, saves files to disk and queues them in RabbitMQ; a .NET Windows-service worker consumes the queue and uses Selenium (RemoteWebDriver via Grid) to log in to ICEGATE, read the OTP from a mailbox API, upload documents to eSANCHIT, harvest IRN/DRN and save results via an HTTP DB service or SQL stored procedure.

routes.POST /api/v2/Jobs/CreateJob: Live endpoint. Validates CorrelationId/TransId/CompanyId, writes base64 files to D:\IRN_DOC\UploadedFiles\{cid}, nulls FileContent, caches 'Queued', publishes to RabbitMQ, returns 202.
routes.POST /api/v2/Jobs/CreateJob_v1: Legacy. Publishes base64 inside the message and writes nothing to disk; worker cannot process it (broken).
routes.GET /api/v2/Jobs/{cid}: Reads StatusStore; only ever 'Queued' then 404 after 20 min.

classes.StatusStore: IMemoryCache wrapper, 20 min expiry, keyed by CorrelationId. Only the API writes to it.
classes.RabbitPublisher: Singleton connection, channel per publish, durable queue icegate.irn.requests, persistent messages, no publisher confirms, default guest credentials.
classes.SettingsService: Reads SERVER_SETTINGS (ModuleName='IRN') maintenance flag, cached RefreshIntervalMinutes (10). Returns 'Y' on error.

worker.ackPolicy: Ack after processing regardless of success; nack requeue=false on invalid payload/unhandled error; no dead-letter queue
worker.consumer: EventingBasicConsumer with async lambda; shared IModel used concurrently (not thread-safe)

requestFlow: API validates, saves files, caches Queued, publishes UploadRequest
Worker receives message, creates DI scope, resolves RpaUploader
RpaUploader.ProcessUploadAsync: build results DataTable, create RemoteWebDriver (grid)
VerifyOtpWithRetryAsync: login to ICEGATE, wait 15s (mailtracktimedelay), POST mailbox API for OTP, type OTP, wait role-dashboard (2 attempts)
NavigateToESanchitAsync: Services panel -> eSANCHIT -> switch to 2nd window (esanchit/home)
ProcessBatchAsync per Batchsizedoc (10) files: #modal -> #fileIn SendKeys -> #uploadSubmit -> set #docTypeSelect_i -> #submitDocs -> #submitDocsConfirm -> wait #irn_0 -> read irn_i/drn_i
finally: quit driver; save XML via PostJobPayloadAsync (UseApiSave=true) or SQL SP IMP_EXP_IRN_AUTOMATION_INS_UPD_DEL_BG (UseApiSave=false; shipped config is false); delete job folder
Worker publishes UploadResult to results queue and acks

externalDependencies.seleniumGrid: http://localhost:4444; compose has hub 4.21.0 + one Chrome node only, while appsettings selects Firefox
externalDependencies.sql: ImpexLogin DB on SERVER\SQLEXPRESS (sa credentials committed in appsettings)

notes.views: No MVC views exist; API is JSON only. The 'view' is the status endpoint and the ICEGATE pages the worker automates.
notes.resultChannel: The real result channel is the DB-service/SQL save, not the results queue or GET status endpoint.
notes.repoHygiene: README is the GitLab template; .http file references /weatherforecast; docker-compose volume/path do not match worker paths.

security.title: Path traversal / arbitrary recursive delete
security.detail: FileName and CorrelationId are used unsanitised in Path.Combine (API Program.cs:175,188); worker Directory.Delete(recursive) at RpaUploader.cs:1044. API has no authentication.

security.title: Secrets logged
security.detail: ICEGATE password (RpaUploader.cs:254), mailbox password (RpaUploader.cs:843), DB connection string (SettingsService.cs:64), full request via {@Request} in v1 (Program.cs:115).

security.title: Committed secrets and plain HTTP
security.detail: sa password in both appsettings.json; OTP mailbox and DB-service calls use http://.

correctness.title: Stale Icegateerror saved on success
correctness.detail: Not cleared after a successful retry (RpaUploader.cs:300).

correctness.title: Redirect wait passes immediately
correctness.detail: RpaUploader.cs:262 Url.Contains(login base URL) is already true; slow OTP redirect (>2s) treated as login failure.

correctness.title: Driver creation outside try/finally
correctness.detail: RpaUploader.cs:96; grid failure means no DB save of error and no folder cleanup. Retry only covers Selenium Manager error.

correctness.title: Grid capacity vs prefetch
correctness.detail: Prefetch 5, compose has one Chrome node with 1 session; new-session requests exceed 90s TimeoutSeconds.

correctness.title: IRN data loss on save failure
correctness.detail: Save errors only logged, folder deleted anyway; DeleteCorrelationFolder not guarded.

correctness.title: IRNs matched by position
correctness.detail: irn_i/drn_i mapped to batch[i]; fileName_i element is not read.

correctness.title: Silent partial failures
correctness.detail: WaitForElementAsync/WaitForIrnAsync return silently after 3 refreshes; HarvestIrnResult skips missing IRNs; SetDocumentType errors only warn; job still Success=true.

correctness.title: API vs SQL save payload differ
correctness.detail: API save hardcodes jobNo='1234' and client_Name=TransId (RpaUploader.cs:779); SQL uses real Client; mFlag 's' vs 'S'.

correctness.title: Login lockout / OTP race
correctness.detail: Retries with same credentials; parallel jobs sharing a mailbox may read each other's or stale OTP (unverified, depends on mail service).

correctness.title: maxSizeMb false positives (unverified)
correctness.detail: Any non-empty innerHTML flags an error.

correctness.title: Second batch may fail (unverified)
correctness.detail: #modal may not exist on the submit screen.

correctness.title: Upload path / file detector
correctness.detail: No LocalFileDetector; paths must exist on grid node; API hardcodes D:\IRN_DOC\UploadedFiles vs worker FilePath config; FolderPath ignored.

correctness.title: Maintenance override and v1
correctness.detail: Program.cs:160 forces maintenanceFlag='N' in CreateJob; SettingsService returns 'Y' on DB error blocking v1 with 200.

correctness.title: Status/results not wired
correctness.detail: Worker never updates StatusStore; results queue has no consumer and grows unbounded.

correctness.title: Worker concurrency/shutdown
correctness.detail: Shared IModel across concurrent jobs; StopAsync closes channel mid-job so messages are redelivered (possible duplicate IRN runs); no DLQ.

minor: PostOTPPayloadAsync uses new HttpClient per call and ignores status code
HandleAutomationErrorAsync uses exact URL match and may inspect wrong window
Unused packages: Selenium.WebDriver.ChromeDriver, NLog.Web in worker
Unused driver service objects and Driverpath/SeleniumManagerSourceExe config effectively dead with RemoteWebDriver
API LoadConfigurationFromAppSettings has no NLog section (unverified)
Error message says 'JobNo is required' when TransId missing
docker-compose has Chrome node only but config selects Firefox

suggestedFixOrder: Sanitise FileName/CorrelationId and add API auth
Remove password/connection-string logging and rotate committed secrets
Clear Icegateerror on success; fix OTP redirect wait to check 'otp-verification' only
Move driver creation inside try; guard folder deletion
Add results-queue consumer to update StatusStore, or drop GetJob
Cap prefetch at grid session count
Match IRNs by file name and fail job when a file gets no IRN
